Reading notes and topic notes from outside the modelling work. The material
itself is written in Google Docs and stays there; these pages say what each
document holds and link to it. Sharing is set per document, so a link may ask
for permission.

Notes on pharmacometrics practice are in the
[Learning Guides](../guides/index.qmd), and checklists for the modelling work
are on the [Pharmacometrics Tools](../pmx-tools.qmd) page.

## Topics

- [Wisdom](topics/wisdom.qmd). The documents on meaning and on the tools for
  living, and the book notes that sit alongside them.
- [Parenting](topics/parenting.qmd).
- [Exercise](topics/exercise.qmd). The exercise notes in Google Docs, and every
  note tagged exercise.
- [Buddhism](topics/buddhism.qmd). The learning guide, the ten oxherding
  pictures and the eightfold path, in Google Docs.

## Books

- [Designing Your Life](books/designing-your-life.qmd). Burnett and Evans on
  treating a career as a design problem rather than a search for one right
  answer.
- [The Problem of the Puer Aeternus](books/puer-aeternus.qmd). Von Franz on the
  adult who keeps life provisional, and on work as the way out.
- [Finding Meaning in the Second Half of Life](books/second-half-of-life.qmd).
  Hollis on the second half as its own task.
- [Shambhala: The Sacred Path of the Warrior](books/shambala.qmd). Trungpa on
  basic goodness, and on bravery as facing yourself without deception.
- [Way of the Peaceful Warrior](books/way-of-the-peaceful-warrior.qmd). Millman
  on training as a way of living, and on there being no ordinary moments.

## Concepts

- [Acceptance and Commitment Therapy](concepts/acceptance-and-commitment-therapy.qmd).
  Workability rather than truth as the test applied to a thought, and the six
  processes of psychological flexibility.
- [Internal Family Systems](concepts/ifs.qmd). The mind as a set of parts, the
  protective role behind a destructive behaviour, and the Self that does the
  work.
- [Fear-Setting](concepts/fear-setting.qmd). Ferriss's three pages: the feared
  outcome, how to prevent and repair it, and the cost of inaction.
- [Boundaries](concepts/boundaries.qmd).
- [Negotiation](concepts/negotiation.qmd).

## Blog Posts

- [Two Hours a Week](blog-posts/two-hours-a-week.qmd). Pallone on strength
  training and cardio: both help, and 60 to 90 minutes a week of resistance
  training could be enough.
- [Everyone Wants a Child Like Eileen Gu](blog-posts/everyone-wants-a-child-like-eileen.qmd).
  Gordeljevic on accomplished children coming out of demanding childhoods, and
  on parenting that is warm and expects a lot at once.

## Movies

- [Stutz](movies/stutz.qmd). Tools to be used at the moment the difficulty
  arrives, and the three conditions Stutz says cannot be escaped.
